model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the retrieval ratio (%) for various large language models (LLMs) in the context of knowledge-grounded discussion summarization, as presented in the paper. The horizontal axis lists the model names, including GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus, arranged in the order they appear in the chart. The vertical axis represents the retrieval ratio (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50. Each bar is colored differently and labeled with its corresponding retrieval ratio value: GPT-4o is 34.11%, GPT-4-turbo is 29.07%, GPT-4o-mini is 29.16%, Claude 3 Opus is 43.57%, Claude 3.5 Sonnet is 25.92%, Claude 3.5 Haiku is 31.56%, Gemini 1.5 Pro is 28.49%, Llama-3.1-405B is 39.37%, Mistral Large is 37.99%, DeepSeek-V3 is 31.04%, Qwen-Max is 46.94%, and GLM-4-Plus is 43.58%. The chart does not indicate any sorting of the bars, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors and labeled values. The caption notes that 0.90% of LLMs are mentioned, and that models are generally classified as conservative (ratio < 30.90%) or open retrievers (ratio > 38.90%), though the chart's y-axis scale (0–50) and the specific threshold values (30.90% and 38.90%) do not align with the stated classification boundaries.
